description: 卡罗-卡恩推进变 B12 — 识别反击点：被压方的自救

intro.popup_en: Space Cramping, Lesson 2: Being cramped does not mean you must lose. White's e5 wedge restricts Black, but Black has a key counterattacking point. Can you find it?
intro.popup:
空间挤压 第2课

被挤压不等于必输！

白方e5楔子压制了黑方空间
但黑方有一个关键反击点——

你能找到这个格子吗？

outro.popup_en: Black's routes out of a cramped position include ...f6 to strike the e5 wedge, ...c4 to stabilize queenside space, and a knight maneuver via Ng6 toward h4. Recognize the space problem, then find a counterattack.
outro.popup:
反击点总结

被压方的三条出路：
① ...f6：直接打击e5楔子
② ...c4：稳固翼侧空间
③ Ng6→Nh4：骑士渗入

识别挤压 → 找反击点！

moves.popup_en: ...c6 begins the Caro-Kann, preparing ...d5 while keeping the bishop's development route open.
moves.popup:
c6！卡罗-卡恩防御
准备d5，同时为象留好发展路线

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances a wedge. Unlike in the French Defense, Black's bishop has not been trapped on c8.
moves.popup:
e5！白方楔子推进！
对比法国防御：黑方象还没被关住！

moves.popup_en: ...Bf5! This is a key Caro-Kann advantage: Black develops the bishop before the structure closes. Unlike in the French, the bishop is already active outside the pawn chain.
moves.popup:
Bf5！卡罗-卡恩的精华！

e5推进之前/同时，象已经溜出来！
对比法国：象被关在c8
卡罗：象在f5，自由活跃！

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces d5. Here it does not trap the bishop, which has already developed to f5.
moves.popup:
e6 稳固d5
这次e6封的不是象，象已经在f5外面了！

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black attacks d4, a key counterattacking resource for the cramped side.
moves.popup:
c5！攻击d4！
这是被压方的核心反击手段

moves.popup_en: Be3 defends d4 and reinforces White's center.
...Nd7! The knight prepares to reroute via e7 to g6, beginning a useful counterplay route.
moves.popup:
Nd7！
马到d7，为下一步Nge7→Ng6做准备
马的路线开始展开……

moves.popup_en: c3 supports d4 and keeps White's position stable.
...Nge7! Black's g8-knight moves out and aims for g6.
Nbd2 develops and supports the center.
...Ng6! The knight reaches its target. It attacks the side of the e5 wedge and prepares ...f5 or ...Nh4, increasing the pressure on White.
moves.popup:
Ng6！马到达目标格！

Ng6的威力：
① 正对e5楔子侧面
② 准备...f5或...Nh4
③ 紧逼白方！

moves.popup_en: h4! White threatens h5 and hxg6 to drive away the knight. The counterplay begins: who will seize the initiative?
moves.popup:
h4！白方威胁h5-hxg6赶走Ng6！
反制来了——谁能主动？

moves.popup_en: h5! Black locks the kingside and keeps the knight on g6 stable. White's h4-h5 plan has failed, and Black has seized the initiative.
moves.popup:
h5！封锁！
黑方主动！h5稳固了Ng6
白方h4-h5计划失败！

moves.popup_en: Nb3 attacks c5, trying to undermine the base of Black's counterattack. Black can stabilize with ...cxd4 or ...c4; the key question is when to strike with ...f6 against the head of White's chain.
moves.popup:
Nb3 攻击c5
白方试图动摇黑方反击基础

黑方下一步：...cxd4或...c4稳固

关键问题：黑方的...f6何时打出？
那是最终的爆破点！
